evidence.evidence_text: Therefore, we propose a novel Unified Legal Retriever (UniLR) capable of performing multiple legal retrieval tasks for LLMs.
Specifically, we introduce attention supervision to guide the retriever in focusing on key elements during knowledge encoding.
Next, we design a graph-based method to integrate meta information through a heterogeneous graph, further enriching the knowledge representation.
